Got it—40 psi is your “low‑pressure” threshold.  
If any of your tires drop below that, it’s time to get them checked or replaced.  

**What to do if you notice a low reading:**

1. **Check the pressure**  
   • Use a reliable tire gauge (digital or analog).  
   • Remove the valve cap, press the gauge onto the valve stem, and read the psi.  
   • Repeat for all four tires (and the spare, if you have one).

2. **If any tire is < 40 psi**  
   • **Stop safely** (preferably on a flat surface).  
   • **Inflate** to the recommended psi (usually listed on the tire sidewall).  
   • If you can’t inflate it yourself, head to a nearby tire shop.

**Nearest tire service center (for quick help):**

- **QuickFix Tire & Auto**  
  1234 Main St, Springfield, IL 62701  
  Phone: (555) 123‑4567  
  Distance: ~2.5 mi from your current location

**Directions (if you’re heading there):**

1. Head west on Main St toward Oak Ave.  
2. Turn right onto Oak Ave.  
3. Continue straight for 1.2 mi; the shop will be on your left.
